calculation.description: Ranks assets by prior 20-session return, amplified only when the prior session's volume exceeds its trailing 20-session median. All inputs are shifted so the signal is available after the completed prior session. Zero or missing volume is treated as unavailable.

validation.regime_notes: Positive pooled daily IC across 1,449 date-level cross-sectional observations in the 15-asset benchmark; average cross-section 8.92. Five- and ten-session horizons were also positive. Small cross-section and selective coverage require conservative monitoring.

provenance.lookahead_control: forward returns shifted from contemporaneous close; signal inputs shifted to completed bar
